description: 12-second rally video (the 'VIP anon' clip): Donald Trump walks a stadium walkway and points toward a crowd section; a split-screen replay shows the section he faces, where a man wears a large flag-styled Q t-shirt printed 'WHY IS THIS RELEVANT?' beside fans in TRUMP PENCE shirts filming on phones. Circulated as proof Trump pointed at the Q-shirt attendee; the video shows the point and the shirt, not intent.
text: TRUMP PENCE. Q. WHY IS THIS RELEVANT?
flags: The 'pointed at the Q shirt on purpose' reading is the community's claim — the footage shows a point toward that section, nothing more

description: 8-second movie clip used as a reaction meme: Deadpool (masked, in costume) sits in a crowded movie theater calmly eating popcorn from a Cinépolis bucket printed with his own image — the Deadpool 2 promotional theater scene. Filename adds the 4chan laugh 'KEEek'.

13-second Right Side Broadcasting Network 'LIVE CLEVELAND' rally clip: Donald Trump on stage acknowledging the crowd amid MAKE AMERICA SAFE/PROUD/STRONG AGAIN, WOMEN FOR TRUMP, DRAIN THE SWAMP and JOBS VS MOBS signs and a TRUMP 2020 banner — the November 5 2018 Cleveland rally. Filename 'trumpdoublepointatq' carries the community's claim that Trump double-pointed at a Q sign or shirt in the crowd.
text: LIVE. CLEVELAND. RIGHT SIDE BROADCASTING NETWORK. MAKE AMERICA SAFE AGAIN. MAKE AMERICA PROUD AGAIN. MAKE AMERICA STRONG AGAIN. WOMEN FOR TRUMP. DRAIN THE SWAMP. JOBS VS MOBS. TRUMP 2020. GET OUT AND VOTE.
flags: The 'double point at Q' is the filename's/community's claim — what Q item he pointed toward is not identifiable in the frames
